metadata.verification_policy: Every row cites an official Kalshi documentation URL. Unconfirmed values are intentionally left blank and cross-listed in flagged_irregularities.json.

environments.auth_required: Public reads: No; Trading/Portfolio: Yes (RSA-PSS SHA-256 or Ed25519)
environments.notes: Dedicated external Trade API host recommended by Kalshi for Demo API integrations.
Shared legacy Demo host; remains supported for compatibility with existing clients.
Dedicated Demo WebSocket host for real-time orderbook_delta, ticker, trade, fill, and market_lifecycle_v2 feeds.
Legacy shared Demo WebSocket host; remains supported for compatibility.

environments.surface: User Fill & Order WebSocket (Demo - Low Latency)
environments.notes: Dedicated per-user host serving fill and user_orders channels; replaces deprecated warp-ws host.
Demo credentials are not shared with production. Prices and market behavior may not reflect real markets.

rest_endpoints.purpose: List events (supports status=unopened|open|closed|settled, with_nested_markets=true, cursor pagination).
rest_endpoints.verified_caveat: liquidity and liquidity_dollars fields on nested markets are deprecated and return 0.

rest_endpoints.purpose: Retrieve single event metadata, settlement sources, and nested markets (supports exclude_markets=true).
rest_endpoints.verified_caveat: Settled nested markets older than market_settled_ts are omitted; use historical endpoints for archived markets.

rest_endpoints.purpose: List markets with filters (series_ticker, event_ticker, status=unopened|open|paused|closed|settled, limit, cursor).
rest_endpoints.verified_caveat: liquidity and liquidity_dollars are deprecated (return 0). Settled markets older than market_settled_ts move to /historical/markets.

rest_endpoints.purpose: Retrieve active YES bids and NO bids (sorted ascending; best bid is last element) with contract quantities at each price.
rest_endpoints.verified_caveat: Returns yes_dollars and no_dollars under orderbook_fp; YES ask at price P equals NO bid at (1.00 - P). Depth range 0-100.

rest_endpoints.purpose: Batch retrieve orderbooks for up to 100 market tickers via tickers query parameter.
rest_endpoints.verified_caveat: Ideal for tracking multi-market liquidity depth across the 5 target topics.

rest_endpoints.purpose: Retrieve OHLC candlestick history for a market.
rest_endpoints.verified_caveat: Valid period_interval values are 1 (1 minute), 60 (1 hour), and 1440 (1 day). No native 1-second REST candlesticks.

rest_endpoints.purpose: Retrieve public trade prints with yes_price_dollars and no_price_dollars.
rest_endpoints.verified_caveat: Trades older than trades_created_ts must be fetched from GET /historical/trades.

rest_endpoints.bucket: Dedicated Balance Bucket (1 req/s Basic/Advanced; 5 req/s higher)
rest_endpoints.purpose: Fetch Demo account cash balance and portfolio value (supports optional subaccount parameter).
rest_endpoints.verified_caveat: Dedicated bucket with 1-second capacity (no burst). React to WebSocket fills instead of high-frequency polling.

rest_endpoints.purpose: List open or settled portfolio positions (settlement_status=unsettled|settled|all).
rest_endpoints.verified_caveat: Archived settled positions move to GET /historical/positions after whole-event handoff.

rest_endpoints.purpose: List authenticated user fills with yes_price_dollars and no_price_dollars.
rest_endpoints.verified_caveat: Fills older than trades_created_ts move to GET /historical/fills.

rest_endpoints.purpose: Create Order (V2) using fixed-point dollar prices and bid/ask side.
rest_endpoints.verified_caveat: Preferred over legacy POST /portfolio/orders which carries 10x write token cost.

rest_endpoints.purpose: Return cutoff timestamps partitioning live endpoints vs /historical/* endpoints.
rest_endpoints.verified_caveat: Query before paginating settled markets, trades, orders, or archived positions.

rest_endpoints.purpose: Inspect current account rate-limit tier, read/write token refill rates, and burst capacity.
rest_endpoints.verified_caveat: Unauthenticated public rate limits are not numerically specified in public docs (flagged).

websocket_channels.purpose: Real-time price, bid/ask, and volume ticker updates used for >= $0.10 swing detection and seconds-level chart aggregation.
Initial orderbook_snapshot plus incremental orderbook_delta updates tracking available contracts at every price level.
Public trade execution stream for real-time tape and sudden price-jump verification.
Lifecycle events (created, activated, deactivated, close_date_updated, determined, settled, metadata_updated) including settlement_value for Yes/No resolution tracking.
Real-time user execution fill updates (also available on low-latency wss://user-ws.demo.kalshi.co/trade-api/ws/v2).

auth_headers.description: Your Demo API key ID generated on https://demo.kalshi.co/
Current Unix timestamp in milliseconds as a string
Base64 signature of (timestamp + HTTP_METHOD + path_without_query_string) using RSA-PSS SHA-256 (salt length = digest length) or Ed25519

unverified_runtime_parameters.reason: Official docs state separate limits apply and advise backing off on HTTP 429, without stating a numeric threshold.
Build sandbox restricts outbound HTTP to GitHub/npm/PyPI; live CORS response header must be confirmed in browser DevTools.
